escena: SCENE (a set being rigged, warehouse in Lima, late afternoon): she wears the Efeonce team polo and the Efeonce cap — field register, on location. A steel rail crosses the RIGHT half of the frame in a hard diagonal, sharp along its whole length, passing in front of her WITHOUT covering her face. A hard low sun beam comes from the right and lights her and the dust in the air; the reserved brick wall down the LEFT side stays in its own even shadow, nothing crossing it. A large AZURE-BLUE lighting panel stands lit in the right background. An ORANGE strip of marking tape runs along the floor at the right edge. Caught AT THE INSTANT she locks a clamp shut. 35mm at f/4. Everything is completely unbranded beyond the Efeonce garments.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of a matte black flight case at the bottom of the frame, unlit
